gaps.sentence: They put ___ the meeting until everyone could attend.
The bonus made up ___ all the overtime we had done.
gaps.explanation: make up FOR something = compensate for it.

gaps.sentence: Sales figures have tailed ___ since the summer.
If you don't know the word, look it ___ in a dictionary.
gaps.explanation: look a word up = find it in a dictionary/reference.

gaps.sentence: Their son grew ___ and moved abroad.
Prices levelled ___ after the crazy spring market.
gaps.explanation: level off = stop rising or falling and stay the same.

gaps.sentence: The evening ___ off with a quiz and ended with dancing.
The match was called ___ because of the storm.
